15	class ClientRegistry:
16	    """Thread-safe registry of connected WebSocket clients with channel support."""

18	    def __init__(self):
19	        self.clients: Dict[str, object] = {}
20	        self.channels: Dict[str, set] = {}
21	        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()
22	
23	    async def register(self, client_id: str, websocket: object):
24	        async with self.lock:
25	            self.clients[client_id] = websocket
26	
27	    async def unregister(self, client_id: str):
28	        async with self.lock:
29	            self.clients.pop(client_id, None)
30	            for channel_subscribers in self.channels.values():
31	                channel_subscribers.discard(client_id)
32	            self.channels = {ch: subs for ch, subs in self.channels.items() if subs}
33	
34	    async def subscribe(self, client_id: str, channel: str):
35	        """Subscribe client to a channel."""
36	        async with self.lock:
37	            if client_id in self.clients:
38	                if channel not in self.channels:
39	                    self.channels[channel] = set()
40	                self.channels[channel].add(client_id)
41	                return True
42	        return False
43	
44	    async def unsubscribe(self, client_id: str, channel: str):
45	        """Unsubscribe client from a channel."""
46	        async with self.lock:
47	            if channel in self.channels:
48	                self.channels[channel].discard(client_id)
49	                if not self.channels[channel]:
50	                    del self.channels[channel]
51	                return True
52	        return False
53	
54	    async def get_channels(self) -> dict:
55	        """Get all channels with subscriber counts."""
56	        async with self.lock:
57	            return {ch: len(subs) for ch, subs in self.channels.items()}
58	
59	    async def get_channel_subscribers(self, channel: str) -> list:
60	        """Get subscriber IDs for a specific channel."""
61	        async with self.lock:
62	            return list(self.channels.get(channel, set()))
63	
64	    async def get_client_count(self) -> int:
65	        async with self.lock:

67

69	        """Send message to clients. If channel is specified, only to that channel's subscribers."""
70	        async with self.lock:
